name: Chioggia (Italy)
description: Red field charged at the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Chioggia (a red lion rampant on white) within branches, with five thin white horizontal stripes at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Chioggia, a comune in Veneto; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 3 March 1988.
